_note: Re-derived 2026-08-05 after the six-pair pass. Two groups moved and no others: Corpse Knight joins the token-to-damage payoff group (its 'whenever another creature you control enters, each opponent loses 1 life' is the same entry trigger the other three carry, and it is the only one that causes LIFE LOSS rather than damage, so Bloodletter of Aclazotz doubles it), and Anguished Unmaking joins the noncreature-answer group, which was a one-card component and is the deck's binding axis. No group named a cut card, so nothing was removed. Cathars' Crusade is deliberately NOT filed as a token multiplier — it puts counters on creatures, it does not create tokens. Forerunner of the Legion is deliberately NOT added to the infinite's group: it TUTORS Bloodthirsty Conqueror to the top rather than drawing it, and this file does not model tutors anywhere else (Vampiric Tutor and Demonic Tutor are in the 99 and appear in no group). Stack 009 verified the payoff group composing: nine triggers, 12 damage per opponent off one two-mana Vampire through a single doubler.
